item.guhs.roze_zaadjes.lore: From the pink grass of the Singing Meadow. Plant them on farmland: pink grain grows from them.
item.guhs.roze_graan.lore: It glitters a little. Nobody knows why. Njeg, it just does.
item.guhs.roze_broodje.lore: Guhs and Blubs adore it: it tames them just as well as a kaasknabbel. Vahoeg tasty!
item.guhs.roze_knabbelkoekje.lore: A cookie with a kaasknabbel in it. A little snack for your guh (and secretly for you too).
